text:
alex (partnerships): Heads-up — trying to lock a joint demo window with FlowGate (gateway), LangChain core team, and Nimbus Orchestrator. Need SSO + marketplace listing details. Proposed dates: May 8-12. Thoughts?

tanya (solutions): +1 for May 8 but runway? we need SSO certs and a test tenant from FlowGate

raj (eng): ok, SSO work: we need SP metadata and IdP thumbprint. flowgate said they'd provide `flowgate-saml-metadata.xml` by EOD Fri.

alex (partnerships): @tanya can you confirm FlowGate contact and whether they can provide a staging tenant with 50k tokens/day test quota?

tanya (solutions): confirmed. contact is @maria_flowgate. staging tenant = yes, quota ok. I'll DM Maria now.

jen (marketing): need 2 weeks for joint blog + social assets. May 8 is tight. If demo is May 8, announce May 15?

raj (eng): deployment note: for marketplace listing we need a small manifest: `name`, `short_description`, `integration_url`, `support_email`. I'll draft.

alex (partnerships): draft manifest would be helpful. Also need the co-announcement embargo date — we should sync with legal.

jen (marketing): legal ok with embargo May 12. if demo on May 10, we can announce May 12.

tanya (solutions): checklist I propose:
- SSO SAML exchange
- test tenant + webhook endpoints
- demo script + reproducible dataset
- pricing/blurb for marketplace
- joint support Slack channel

raj (eng): adding infra checks:
```
- ensure private deployment flag enabled
- token quotas: 50k/day in staging
- model pinned to rdl-v1.2
- fallback model: rdl-v1.0
```

alex (partnerships): should we include LlamaIndex integration highlight? LangChain team wants a snippet showing pipeline orchestration.

tanya (solutions): yes, highlight both LlamaIndex indexing + LangChain orchestration in demo. we can reuse existing sample repo: github.com/redwood/integration-samples/tooling-onramp

jen (marketing): need 3 screenshots + 30s clip. @raj can you run the clip capture during rehearsal?

raj (eng): yep, will capture during canary run.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: staging -> demo on 2024-05-09T22:00Z. CI passed. build 9821.

alex (partnerships): OK locking May 10 demo window (internal) / public announce May 12. action owners:
- SSO metadata: raj
- staging tenant & contact: tanya
- marketing assets & embargo: jen
- demo script & runbook: alex

tanya (solutions): I'll set up joint Slack channel #partners-flowgate-demo and invite @maria_flowgate

jen (marketing): will prepare social copy and a joint quote template

raj (eng): I'll post SP metadata in the channel once ready. ETA EOD Thu.

alex (partnerships): thanks all. quick check — anyone foresee regulatory/PCI issues? we only use staging data, no real PII.

jen (marketing): legal already flagged no PII. good.

alex (partnerships): cool — moving this to a small follow-up thread in #calendar to get confirmed invites. :rocket:
